notes.title: DotX Available Now!
notes.notes:
DotX is a 'mouse only' game, where you will challenge your ability to control the mouse, as well as verify your emotional resistance.
Pick up the dots and avoid bumping into the walls, as long as your health bar didn't reach zero.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/954420/DotX/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33684726/dbc98c8e5ef621a3da5ef6b4a741a587581d7b82.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: DotX - Pre-release Build #6553
notes.notes:
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added mouse sensitivity settings
[*]Added new UI elements
[*]Removed background settings (now backgrounds are random on all levels)
[*]Added Steam achievements
[*]Added integration with Steam Cloud
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Time to spawn points reduced from 0.5 sec to 0.33 sec
[*]Changed life steal variable on some levels
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed incorrect point spawns on some levels
[*]Fixed rare bug with incorrect wall collider
[*]Fixed incorrect positions of UI elements, when the player changed resolution
[/list]
